name: 39564 · Ocean Springs, MS
findings: ZIP 39564 (Ocean Springs) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39564 (Ocean Springs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39564 (Ocean Springs) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
